query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN is_new_tobacco_isolate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_isolates,
       COUNT(DISTINCT category) as categories,
       COUNT(DISTINCT subcategory) as subcategories
FROM perique_compounds;
